items.acceptance: 1. `python -m todo --version` exits 0 and stdout (stripped) equals "todo " + todo.__version__.
evidence: python -m todo --version -> exit=0, stdout='todo 0.1.0\n' (cat -A: 'todo 0.1.0$'), stderr empty

items.acceptance: 3. `python -m todo` with no arguments exits 2, 'usage' on stderr, stdout empty.
evidence: python -m todo -> exit=2, stdout=[], stderr='usage: todo [-h] [--version] {} ...\ntodo: error: a command is required'
items.impact: None. Cosmetic: usage shows an empty '{}' choices placeholder until S2 registers a command.

evidence: python -m todo --bogus -> exit=2, stdout=[], stderr='usage: todo [-h] [--version] {} ...\ntodo: error: unrecognized arguments: --bogus'

items.acceptance: 5. `main(["--version"])` raises SystemExit(0); main accepts argv and ignores sys.argv when given.
evidence: with sys.argv=['todo','--bogus-should-be-ignored']: main(['--version']) printed 'todo 0.1.0', SystemExit code=0; main([]) -> SystemExit code=2

items.acceptance: 6. `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` exits 0 and runs >= 1 test.
evidence: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v -> 'Ran 15 tests ... OK', exit=0 (11 acceptance + 4 smoke)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -v -> 'Ran 15 tests ... OK', exit=0

items.acceptance: 8. tests/__init__.py, tests/acceptance/__init__.py, todo/__init__.py, todo/__main__.py, todo/cli.py exist.
evidence: ls -l -> all five present (tests/*__init__.py 0 bytes; todo/__init__.py 55B; todo/__main__.py 56B; todo/cli.py 1068B)
todo/__main__.py content is exactly 'import sys; from todo.cli import main; sys.exit(main())'
grep -rnE '^\s*(import|from)\s' todo/ -> sys, todo.cli, argparse, importlib, todo only
python -I import of todo, todo.cli succeeds; non-stdlib modules loaded: only todo, todo.cli (plus site's sitecustomize)

contract_issues: QA-side test defect: tests/acceptance/s0/test_s0_acceptance.py::test_a9_imports_resolve_in_isolated_python runs `python -I -S`; -I implies -E, so PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE is ignored and todo/__pycache__/*.pyc is created on every suite run (reproduced: rm -rf todo/__pycache__; run suite; dir reappears). Untracked and gitignored, so snapshot hashes are unaffected (verified 0 mismatches vs .harness/state/snapshot-qa-S0.json); QA removed the generated dir after runs. Recommend adding -B to that invocation in the S0 acceptance test.

Contract does not state main()'s behaviour when no subcommand is parsed beyond the example (usage, exit 2); implementation uses parser.error('a command is required'), and also parser.error for a command lacking func. Consider making this explicit in the S2 contract so later slices keep it.
Contract Interface requires Python 3.10+ implicitly (`list[str] | None` signature); minimum Python version is not stated.
